review_description: The initial quote in 2011 for a 1.5kw system (with 7 x 200w Hyundai Panels & 2kw Solar King Inverter) seemed reasonable. My installation was under Fair Trading supervision after the company was found out using sub-qualified installers. Years later in 2018, the Solar King Inverter had already shown signs of failure. In the end not a very good purchase from a company that is not in existence anymore.
